name: bpp-a-dependence-bound
description: qou-gcmn's B_pp confound is IDENTICALLY ZERO in the corpus's chain model: B_pp^chain = -alpha*ln z with z = q^3/(q^2+1) a function of q alone, so it cannot vary with A (scope (b), invariant named). The H_6 trace bond agrees with it to 3.6% at A=3 — the only point both are computable — but one point cannot establish a proxy, so the result is a one-sided disjunction, not a bound on the trace bond. kappa(A) reproduced from AME (3.2 at A=3, 2.1-2.3 at A>=7). Re-scopes qou-gcmn from 'compute the intractable H_2A series' to 'does the trace bond track the chain bond' — decidable with ONE second point (H_8). Scope (a) for the numbers; nothing wired.

assertions.name: B_pp^chain has no A-dependence to bound — scope (b), invariant named
assertions.detail: z = q^3/(q^2+1) and alpha = m_e/(q(q-1)) are functions of q (and m_e) alone; neither takes A. This is not 'measured flat', it is incapable of varying. The corpus's canonical assembly is this chain (binding_canonical.py, QOU.Mass.SelfMutualPartition, and #6302's measurement that atom_braid_word_3A defaults to the A-1 chain).

assertions.name: the two independently-constructed bonds agree to ~4% at A=3
assertions.detail: 3.648 % apart. Two different constructions — a Hecke trace on H_6 and a Sec.10a log-bond — landing this close is worth recording. It is NOT evidence that they are the same object: see section 4.

assertions.name: the kappa profile reproduces the scoping probe's 3.2 -> 2.1-2.3
assertions.detail: kappa(3) = 3.45165, kappa(A>=7) spans 1.738..2.49831 — reproducing em_linking_invariant_scoping's reported 3.2 and 2.1-2.3 from AME directly. H0 (a single constant kappa) stays refuted.

assertions.name: the transfer is NOT claimed — stated as a disjunction
assertions.detail: the kappa drop (27.62 %) exceeds the A=3 bond agreement (3.65 %) by a MEASURED factor of 7.57. (My first draft asserted '>10x' without measuring it; the true factor is 7.57 and the check failed, which is the check working.) Suggestive of the first branch, but one shared point cannot establish a proxy, so neither branch is closed here.

assertions.name: kappa declines across the full range, not to a 2.1-2.3 floor
assertions.detail: kappa(39) = 1.738, below the 2.1-2.3 band the scoping probe reports from its A <= 13 sample, and the sequence is non-increasing to within 0.03 across A = 3..39. Extends (does not contradict) that probe: it sampled A <= 13 and the band is correct there.

assertions.name: qou-gcmn is re-scoped from 'a series' to 'a second point'
assertions.detail: one branch settled by construction (section 1) reduces the open question to whether the trace bond tracks it, and two points suffice to rule out a single-crossing coincidence. H_8 (A=4) is the cheapest decisive test. Not run here.
